designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1964 as a migratory waterfowl refuge, Kootenai National Wildlife Refuge provides habitat for more than 220 species of birds, 45 species of mammals, and 22 species of fish.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
